content: BioCrats exclusively brings to you an exciting workshop on scientific illustrations!\r\nWhether you’re working on your thesis, poster, or publication, clear and well-designed illustrations can greatly enhance how you communicate your research. This workshop will cover key design principles, useful tools, and practical tips to help you present bioscience data effectively.  \r\nTo help us design the workshop according to your interests and availability, please take a minute to fill out this google form.
